title: 중소기업인력지원 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Preferential Treatment under Small and Medium Enterprise Support Measures)
When implementing small and medium enterprise support measures, the Minister of SMEs and Startups may give preferential treatment to small and medium enterprises that reduced working hours earlier than the enforcement dates prescribed in the subparagraphs of Article 1 of the Addenda to the Act Partially Amending the Labor Standards Act, Act No. 6974. [Amended on July 26, 2017.]
